component.name: Strider
component.summary: A keyboard-driven file manager in Miller columns

description.p: A ranger- and yazi-style file manager for Wayland: the parent folder, the current one, and a live preview side by side; vim keys with counts, search, marks, visual selection, bookmarks, and tabs; a command line with completion; and copy, move, trash, and delete with undo. Keys, options, and bookmarks are configured in a JSON file.
